title: Browser project calls
responsibility: Expose project, membership, invitation and GitHub connection calls for the signed-in browser.

inputs.name: invitationLink.origin
inputs.description: Site origin to prefix; supplied text is not normalized here.

inputs.name: invitationLink.invitation
inputs.description: Invitation carrying project and invitation IDs; its code is excluded from the link.

outputs.name: invitationLink
outputs.description: Invitation URL with encoded project and invitation IDs.

outputs.name: browserProjects
outputs.description: Methods to list/get/create projects, list members, create/accept invitations and read GitHub status/repositories. Server-side checks determine permissions.
